```{r}

meta_file <- "isd-history.csv"
if (!file_exists(meta_file)) {
  download.file(
    "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/noaa/isd-history.csv",
    destfile = meta_file,
    mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE
  )
}

# Simple version - just gets standard 11-digit US station IDs
us_ids <- read_csv(meta_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(CTRY == "US") |>
  mutate(
    id = paste0(
      str_pad(USAF, 6, pad = "0"),
      str_pad(WBAN, 5, pad = "0")
    )
  ) |>
  pull(id)

# Additional known US prefixes (beyond isd-history.csv)
extra_us_prefixes <- c(
  "^US",       # All COOP stations
  "^K[A-Z]{3}", # ASOS/AWOS (airport) stations
  "^GHCND",    # GHCN-Daily stations
  "^WBAN",     # Legacy WBAN-only stations
  "^ICAO"      # International Civil Aviation Organization
)

```

```{r}
csv_dir <- "/Users/evelynpaul/Desktop/STAT155/stat-155-project/gsod_csv"
files <- dir_ls(csv_dir, regexp = "\\.csv$", type = "file")

station_list <- list()

for (f in files) {
  head_row <- fread(f,
                   skip = 1,
                   nrows = 1,
                   header = FALSE,
                   colClasses = "character",
                   showProgress = FALSE)
  
  st_id <- head_row$V1[1]
  
  if (st_id %in% us_ids | any(str_detect(st_id, extra_us_prefixes))) {
    message("Reading US station ", st_id)
    station_list[[st_id]] <- fread(
      f,
      colClasses = c(STATION = "character"),
      showProgress = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    message("Skipping non-US station ", st_id)
  }
}
```

```{r}

weather_cols <- c(                      
  "STATION", "DATE", "LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "ELEVATION",
  "TAVG", "TMAX", "TMIN",                # temperature core
  "PRCP",                                # daily precip depth
  "SNDP",                                # snow depth on ground
  "CLDD", "HTDD",                        # cooling / heating degree-days
  "DP01", "DP10", "DP1X",                # days ≥ 0.01 / ≥ 0.10 / ≥ 1 in
  "DX32", "DX70", "DX90",                # days ≥ 32 °F, 70 °F, 90 °F
  "DT32", "DT00",                        # days < 32 °F, < 0 °F
  "EMXT", "EMNT",                        # monthly record high / low
  "EMXP",                                # monthly record precip
  "FRSHTT"                               # fog-rain-snow-hail-thunder-tornado flags
)

all_stations <- station_list %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    x %>%
      mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
      select(any_of(weather_cols))  # Only keeps columns in weather_cols
  }) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "STATION") %>%
  distinct(STATION, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    network = case_when(
      str_starts(STATION, "US1") ~ "COOP",
      str_starts(STATION, "GHCND") ~ "GHCN",
      str_detect(STATION, "K[A-Z]{3}") ~ "ASOS/AWOS",  # Airport stations (KXXX)
      TRUE ~ "Other"  # Everything else
    )
  )
```


```{r}

#number data should actually be stay numbers. putting it back
num_cols <- c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "ELEVATION", "TAVG", "TMAX", "TMIN", "PRCP")
all_stations <- all_stations %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(num_cols), ~ {
    nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))
    ifelse(is.finite(nums), nums, NA)  
  }))


# 2. Filter like a blue whale babey
stations_geo <- all_stations %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(LATITUDE), 
    !is.na(LONGITUDE),
    between(LONGITUDE, -180, -50),  
    between(LATITUDE, 15, 72)       
  ) %>%
  arrange(STATION, desc(DATE)) %>%
  distinct(STATION, .keep_all = TRUE)

stations_sf <- stations_geo %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  st_make_valid()

```


```{r}
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
usa <- ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf")

# Create the map
ggplot() +
  # Ocean background
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "lightblue", color = NA) +
  # Land
  geom_sf(data = usa, fill = "cornsilk", color = NA) +
  # Counties
  geom_sf(data = counties, fill = NA, color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.1) +
  # Stations
  geom_sf(data = stations_sf, color = "red", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Zoom to CONUS
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-125, -65), ylim = c(25, 50)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  # Plot cropland with its native color scale
  geom_spatraster(data = cropland, alpha = 0.7) +  # alpha controls translucency
  # Overlay weather stations
  geom_sf(data = stations_sf, color = "red", size = 1, alpha = 0.3) +
  # Minimal styling
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "US Cropland with Weather Stations")
```
